integrity_notes: The proof is analytic and uses Jensen's inequality, Tonelli's theorem, Haar invariance, Hoeffding's inequality, and absolute continuity of the integral. No finite computation is used as evidence for an infinite statement.
scientific_limitations: The theorem applies to left translates of a Haar-measurable positive-measure set in a compact metrizable group with normalized Haar measure.
It proves equality of infima, not attainment by a countable convex combination.
It does not settle the unrestricted-versus-countable-mixture conjecture for arbitrary set systems.
The construction is existence-based and gives no efficient deterministic selection algorithm.
title: Countable-translate entropy equals \(-\log_2 \alpha\) on compact groups
